13 bridge q values display0: numeric zero, not exact mathematical probability0; source display strings preserved

64 new descriptive rows (8 flow,14 positive-minus-net distributions,42 correlations) do not add model specifications

Positive-minus-net mean2.787–2.885 mg/dL is below-own-baseline area magnitude, not hypoglycemia or a regression coefficient
